title.en: Colombia votes in presidential election that could redefine relations with US
title.zh: 哥伦比亚举行总统选举，可能重新定义与美国的关系

summary.en: The election is held after months of public recrimination between current left-wing President Gustavo Petro and his US counterpart Donald Trump.
summary.zh: 哥伦比亚总统选举在现任左翼总统古斯塔沃·佩特罗与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普之间数月公开相互指责之后举行。

body.en:
The election is being held after months of public recrimination between current left-wing President Gustavo Petro and his US counterpart Donald Trump over a number of issues including drug trafficking and American intervention in the region.

Colombia's constitution prohibits Petro seeking re-election and he has thrown his support behind Iván Cepeda. Challenging him are right-wing candidates Abelardo de la Espriella and Paloma Valencia.

The outcome of the election could redefine which countries the Latin American nation aligns itself with and how the government intends to tackle drug gangs amid spiralling violence.

None of the candidates appear likely to win an outright majority, with a run-off vote expected on 21 June.

Polling suggests Cepeda has the greatest support, with de la Espriella his next-closest rival.

Cepeda has promised to continue with the Petro administration's policy of "total peace", which sought negotiated settlements with armed insurgent groups that engage in drug trafficking - though talks have stalled or fallen apart and there has been renewed violence.

The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) said in a recent report that armed conflict in Colombia last year had affected civilians the most in a decade.

De la Espriella and Valencia have vowed to launch a military crackdown if elected.

Colombia's presidential hopefuls have campaigned amid persistent political violence, with one candidate fatally shot last summer . Last week, de la Espriella appeared at a rally in Medellin behind bulletproof glass.

He and Valencia have expressed a desire to restore Colombia's close security alliance with the US.

Cepeda has insisted, just as Petro did, that Colombia should not be a "vassal state" to the US - though observers have noted that the two nations' historic anti-drugs co-operation has continued during even the most heated disputes.

The capture by US forces of Venezuela's former President Nicolás Maduro in January has left Petro one of the region's few remaining left-wing leaders not ideologically aligned with the Trump administration.

Trump has accused Petro of not doing enough to prevent cocaine from his country winding up on America's streets.

At one point, Trump even called him "a sick man who likes selling cocaine to the United States" and said "he could be next" for US military intervention.

Petro has argued his government has seized the largest amount of drugs in history. But on his watch cocaine production has also soared to record highs, according to the United Nations' United Nations' World Drug Report 2025 . Petro disputes the UN's method of counting.

The two presidents, however, appeared to have mended their relations at a White House meeting in February - after which Trump called his guest "terrific".
body.zh: 这次选举是在现任左翼总统古斯塔沃·佩特罗和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普就贩毒和美国对该地区的干预等一系列问题进行了数月的公开指责之后举行的。 佩特罗无法寻求连任，并支持伊万·塞佩达。挑战他的是中右翼候选人阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉和帕洛玛·瓦伦西亚。 选举结果可能会重新定义这个拉丁美洲国家与哪些国家结盟，以及政府打算如何在暴力升级的情况下打击贩毒团伙。 在周日的民意调查中，似乎没有一位候选人能够赢得绝对多数，预计将于 6 月 21 日进行决选。 民意调查显示，塞佩达获得了最大的支持，德拉埃斯普里埃拉是他第二大的竞争对手。 塞佩达承诺继续推行佩特罗政府的“全面和平”政策，即寻求与从事贩毒的武装叛乱组织通过谈判达成解决方案，尽管谈判已经陷入僵局或破裂，暴力事件再次发生。 红十字国际委员会在最近的一份报告中表示，去年哥伦比亚的武装冲突对平民造成的影响是十年来最严重的。 德拉埃斯普里埃拉和瓦伦西亚誓言，如果当选，将发动军事镇压。 哥伦比亚的总统候选人在持续的政治暴力中竞选，去年夏天一名候选人被枪杀。上周，德拉埃斯普里埃拉出现在麦德林的一次集会上，背后是防弹玻璃。 他和瓦伦西亚表示希望恢复哥伦比亚与美国的密切安全联盟。 塞佩达和佩特罗一样坚称哥伦比亚不应该成为美国的“附庸国”——尽管观察人士指出，即使在最激烈的争端中，两国历史性的禁毒合作仍在继续。 委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗一月份被美军抓获，佩特罗成为该地区为数不多的在意识形态上与特朗普政府不结盟的左翼领导人之一。 特朗普指责佩特罗没有采取足够措施阻止来自他的国家的可卡因流入美国街头。 特朗普甚至一度称他为“一个喜欢向美国出售可卡因的病夫”，并表示“他可能是下一个”美国进行军事干预的人。 佩特罗辩称，他的政府查获了历史上最大数量的毒品。但根据联合国《2025 年世界毒品报告》，在他的领导下，可卡因产量也飙升至历史新高。佩特罗对联合国的统计方法提出异议。 然而，两位总统似乎在二月份的白宫会议上修复了关系——会后特朗普称他的客人“棒极了”。

reflection.en: When leaders engage in public recrimination, their harsh words can easily escalate tensions and stir up anger, impacting international relations. Proverbs reminds us that a gentle answer, even in disagreement, holds the power to de-escalate conflict and foster a more peaceful environment. This principle is vital for all, especially those in positions of...
reflection.zh: 当领导人公开相互指责时，他们的严厉言辞很容易加剧紧张局势并激起愤怒，从而影响国际关系。箴言提醒我们，即使在分歧中，温和的回答也具有化解冲突、营造更和平环境的力量。这一原则对所有人，尤其是身居要职者至关重要。

verse.textEn: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verse.textZh: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言语暴戾，触动怒气。

title.en: US chemical tank disasters remain rare despite recent incidents, experts say
title.zh: 专家称，尽管近期发生事故，美国化学品储罐灾难仍属罕见

summary.en: Experts state that chemical tank disasters in the US are uncommon, despite recent incidents. A tragedy in Washington and a near-miss in California have underscored the inherent risks of chemical spills and explosions, leaving thousands of residents concerned about potential dangers from a large chemical storage tank.
summary.zh: 专家表示，尽管近期发生了一些事故，但美国化学品储罐灾难仍然罕见。华盛顿的一场悲剧和加利福尼亚州的一次险情，突显了化学品泄漏和爆炸的固有风险，使数万名居民对大型化学品储罐的潜在危险感到担忧。

body.en: Tragedy in Washington and near-miss in California cast in sharp relief the risk of chemical spills and explosions For several tense days last week, tens of thousands of southern California residents were left wondering whether a 7,000-gallon chemical storage tank would either explode or spill out into the streets. The episode cast in sharp relief the risk of chemical spills and explosions that lurk behind every corner of modern life. The methyl methacrylate that recently left the city of Garden Grove teetering on the edge of disaster is just one of many toxic chemicals commonly found in American cities. Continue reading...
body.zh: 华盛顿发生的悲剧和加州险些发生的事故使化学品泄漏和爆炸的风险大大缓解。在上周紧张的几天里，数万名南加州居民都在想，一个 7,000 加仑的化学品储罐是否会爆炸或泄漏到街道上。这一事件让人们清楚地认识到潜伏在现代生活各个角落的化学品泄漏和爆炸的风险。最近使加登格罗夫市濒临灾难边缘的甲基丙烯酸甲酯只是美国城市中常见的众多有毒化学物质之一。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The recent chemical incidents highlight the constant need for vigilance and foresight in managing complex industrial systems. Proverbs reminds us that the prudent see danger and take refuge, a principle vital for protecting communities from foreseeable risks. This wisdom calls us to prioritize safety and responsible planning in all our endeavors.
reflection.zh: 近期发生的化学品事故凸显了在管理复杂工业系统时，持续保持警惕和远见的重要性。箴言提醒我们，通达人预见危险就藏躲，这一原则对于保护社区免受可预见的风险至关重要。这种智慧呼吁我们在所有工作中优先考虑安全和负责任的规划。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Triumph of the underdogs: New Yorkers are reveling in the Knicks and Mamdani
title.zh: 弱者的胜利：纽约人沉浸在尼克斯队和马姆达尼的喜悦中

summary.en: New York City residents are experiencing a wave of collective joy and hope, fueled by the recent success of their basketball team, the Knicks, and the visible enthusiasm of their mayor. The city's bars are bustling, reflecting a shared sense of excitement and community spirit.
summary.zh: 纽约市民正沉浸在集体喜悦和希望的浪潮中，这股浪潮源于他们篮球队尼克斯队的近期胜利以及市长亲临现场的积极表现。城里的酒吧比往常更加热闹，反映出一种共同的兴奋和社区精神。

body.en: From watching their team win to watching their mayor in the nosebleeds, residents are feeling hopeful New York City, hardly a city deprived of energy, is having a moment. In the past two weeks, the bars have been even more packed than usual. Several nights a week, usually at around 11pm, there has been a seemingly synchronized honking of horns. Walking around the city, it doesn’t take long to find out why. People wearing New York Knicks jerseys are high-fiving each other, and Knicks flags fly from cars, windows and bodegas, as people celebrate the team reaching the NBA finals – and having the chance to overcome five decades of (mostly) failure. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从看着他们的球队获胜到看着他们的市长流鼻血，居民们都对纽约市充满希望，这个城市并不是一个缺乏活力的城市，而是有一个美好的时刻。在过去的两周里，酒吧比平时更加​​拥挤。每周有几个晚上，通常是晚上 11 点左右，会听到看似同步的喇叭声。在城市里走一圈，很快就能找到原因。穿着纽约尼克斯队球衣的人们互相击掌，尼克斯队的旗帜在汽车、窗户和杂货店里飘扬，人们庆祝球队进入 NBA 总决赛，并有机会克服 50 年（大部分）的失败。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The thrill of a shared victory, like a sports championship, brings communities together in a powerful way, creating moments of collective joy and hope. While these earthly triumphs are wonderful and worth celebrating, they also remind us of the deeper, imperishable joys that endure beyond any season or game.
reflection.zh: 像体育赛事夺冠这样的共同胜利，以一种强大的方式将社区凝聚在一起，创造出集体喜悦和希望的时刻。虽然这些世俗的胜利是美好的，值得庆祝，但它们也提醒我们，有更深刻、不朽的喜乐，超越任何赛季或比赛而长存。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Striking differences in benefit entitlements across UK countries, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现英国各地的福利待遇存在显著差异

summary.en: A new study reveals significant disparities in welfare benefits across the UK, with a low-income family in Scotland potentially receiving £15,000 more annually than an identical household in England. This highlights the emergence of "welfare nationalism" and its impact on benefit entitlements.
summary.zh: 一项新研究显示，英国各地的福利待遇存在显著差异，苏格兰的低收入家庭每年可能比英格兰的同等家庭多获得1.5万英镑。这凸显了“福利民族主义”的出现及其对福利待遇的影响。

body.en: Scottish family on low income receives £15,000 more a year than identical household in England The emergence of “welfare nationalism” in the UK has created striking differences in benefit entitlement that result in a Scottish family on a low income receiving £15,000 a year more in state support than an identical household over the border in England. A typical out of work couple with four children would have received £22,000 a year benefit income in York, compared with £32,000 in Belfast and £37,000 in Glasgow, according to new research on the impact of devolved welfare approaches Continue reading...
body.zh: 苏格兰低收入家庭每年比英格兰的同一家庭多获得 15,000 英镑 英国“福利民族主义”的出现造成了福利权利的显着差异，导致苏格兰低收入家庭每年比英格兰边境的同一家庭多获得 15,000 英镑的国家支持。根据关于下放福利方法影响的最新研究，一对典型的有四个孩子的失业夫妇在约克每年可以获得 22,000 英镑的福利收入，而贝尔法斯特为 32,000 英镑，格拉斯哥为 37,000 英镑继续阅读...

reflection.en: News of differing welfare entitlements across regions within a single nation raises questions about equitable care for all citizens, especially the most vulnerable. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds those in authority of their mandate to "do what is right and just" and to protect the poor and marginalized. This calls us to consider how policies can ensure that...
reflection.zh: 一国之内不同地区福利待遇的差异，引发了人们对如何公平对待所有公民，特别是最弱势群体的疑问。耶利米书22:3提醒掌权者，他们的职责是“秉公行义”，保护贫困和边缘化的人。这促使我们思考，政策如何能确保怜悯和公义始终如一地惠及每一个有需要的人。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Middle East crisis live: Netanyahu says capture of strategic castle is ‘dramatic shift’ in Israel’s Lebanon offensive
title.zh: 中东危机：以色列军队攻占黎巴嫩战略城堡，系26年来最深入入侵

summary.en: The Israeli army has captured a strategic castle in Lebanon, marking its deepest incursion into the country in 26 years. This action occurred despite a nominal ceasefire and shortly before scheduled talks in the US.
summary.zh: 以色列军队占领了黎巴嫩境内的一座战略城堡，这是26年来对该国最深入的一次入侵。此次行动发生在名义上的停火期间，且就在美国即将举行会谈之前。

body.en: Israeli PM says his forces have returned to Beaufort castle ‘united, determined and stronger than ever’ By capturing Beaufort castle and pushing past the Litani river, Israeli forces appear to be positioning themselves for a potential encirclement of Nabatieh , a city that serves as an economic centre and a cultural heartland for southern Lebanon, Lorenzo Tondo writes. Control of the surrounding hills would provide commanding views over large parts of southern Lebanon and the western Bekaa valley, offering a significant tactical advantage. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管名义上停火，而且在美国举行会谈之前不久，纳巴蒂耶市附近的博福特城堡还是被占领。您可以观看下面《卫报》的最新纪录片，了解冲突如何扩大黎巴嫩的分歧。真主党的支持者称该组织为“抵抗组织”，并认为这场冲突事关生死存亡。以色列坚持认为真主党必须解除武装才能实现和平 — — 许多黎巴嫩人也同意这一观点。由于各社区对真主党的未来存在分歧，《卫报》走遍黎巴嫩，了解冲突如何影响全国各地的生活。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of a military incursion despite a ceasefire and impending talks highlights the fragility of peace. Romans 12:18 reminds us of the human responsibility to pursue peace whenever possible. In a world where conflict often seems inevitable, this verse calls us to actively seek harmony and de-escalation.
reflection.zh: 尽管有停火协议和即将举行的会谈，军事入侵的消息凸显了和平的脆弱性。罗马书12:18提醒我们，只要可能，就有责任追求和平。在一个冲突似乎不可避免的世界里，这节经文呼吁我们积极寻求和谐与降级。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Israel seizes castle in Lebanon as it expands ground offensive
title.zh: 以色列扩大地面攻势夺取黎巴嫩城堡

summary.en: The Israeli military says everyone south of the Zahrani river should leave, after it captured the strategic Beaufort Castle.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The Israeli military has increased the zone in southern Lebanon that it has warned residents to evacuate from, as it further expands its ground operations against Hezbollah.

The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) reiterated its warning to everyone south of the Zahrani river to leave.

"Anyone present near Hezbollah elements, facilities or means of combat endangers their life," a spokesman said.

The warning came shortly after the army confirmed it had taken Beaufort Castle, a strategic point on a high ridge above the Litani river.

The latest evacuation warning is the second time in recent days that Israel has told residents to leave the entire south of the country below the Zahrani river.

The IDF spokesman said that a "significant number of IDF ground soldiers" were involved in the operation, which was "currently expanding to additional areas".

It's another clear indication that Israeli ground forces are moving ever deeper into Lebanese territory beyond their original demarcation line of the Litani river.

Meanwhile on Sunday Lebanon's Health Ministry said 13 hospital staff had been injured in an airstrike in the vicinity of Hiram hospital in Tyre, which caused significant damage.

France, which has historical ties with Lebanon, has requested a meeting of the United National Security Council to discuss the Israeli military operations.

Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot told French network BFMTV the situation was a "major mistake for Israel".

"Nothing can justify the prolongation of [Israel's] military operations in Lebanon and its increasingly deep occupation of Lebanese territory," he said.

Just over the Litani river line, the IDF has confirmed it has captured one of the key strategic prizes in the area - Beaufort Castle. It was built as a fortress commanding views from high on the cliffs above the Litani river by the Crusaders some 900 years ago, and has been fought over many times since.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu described the capture as "a dramatic stage and dramatic change in our policy".

"We have broken the barrier of fear. We are taking the initiative, we are operating on all fronts - in Syria, in Gaza, in Lebanon," he said.

Defence Minister Israel Katz recalled a battle the Israeli army fought for the fort 44 years ago. He said the Golani Brigade, which took it then, had returned and raised the Israeli flag above it.

So, it's a highly symbolic as well as strategic victory, as far as Israel is concerned.

For the Lebanese, it's the latest historic landmark to be seized in recent days, while the city of Nabatieh further north appears to be increasingly a target for the IDF.

Katz said control of the castle and the ridge it stands upon was an important step in protecting Israeli communities on the other side of the...
body.zh: 以色列军方在黎巴嫩南部扩大了警告居民撤离的区域，进一步扩大了针对真主党的地面行动。 以色列国防军（IDF）再次警告扎赫拉尼河以南的所有人离开。 “任何靠近真主党分子、设施或作战手段的人都会危及他们的生命，”一位发言人说。 该警告是在军队确认占领博福特城堡后不久发出的，博福特城堡是利塔尼河上方高山上的一个战略要地。 最新的疏散警告是以色列近几天来第二次要求居民离开扎赫拉尼河以下的整个国家南部地区。 以色列国防军发言人表示，“大量以色列国防军地面士兵”参与了此次行动，该行动“目前正在扩大到其他地区”。 这是另一个明确的迹象，表明以色列地面部队正在越过最初的利塔尼河分界线深入黎巴嫩领土。 与此同时，黎巴嫩卫生部周日表示，提尔市希拉姆医院附近的一次空袭造成 13 名医院工作人员受伤，造成重大损失。 与黎巴嫩有着历史渊源的法国已要求召开联合国国家安全委员会会议，讨论以色列的军事行动。 外交部长让-诺埃尔·巴罗告诉法国网络 BFMTV，这种情况是“以色列的一个重大错误”。 他说：“没有任何理由可以证明以色列在黎巴嫩的军事行动的延长以及对黎巴嫩领土日益深入的占领是合理的。” 就在利塔尼河沿岸，以色列国防军确认已占领该地区的关键战略战利品之一——博福特城堡。大约 900 年前，十字军在利塔尼河上方的悬崖上建造了这座堡垒，从高处俯瞰美景，此后曾多次为争夺而战。 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡将此次抓获描述为“一个戏剧性的阶段，也是我们政策的戏剧性变化”。 “我们已经打破了恐惧的障碍。我们正在采取主动，我们在叙利亚、加沙和黎巴嫩的各个战线上开展行动，”他说。 国防部长伊斯雷尔·卡茨回忆了44年前以色列军队为堡垒而战的一场战斗。他说，当时占领该地的戈拉尼旅已经返回，并在上面升起了以色列国旗。 因此，对于以色列而言，这是一次具有高度象征意义和战略意义的胜利。 对于黎巴嫩人来说，这是最近几天占领的最新历史地标，而更北的纳巴蒂耶市似乎越来越成为以色列国防军的目标。 卡茨说，控制城堡及其所在的山脊是保护大洋彼岸以色列社区的重要一步。

title.en: Nigerian retired general abducted with his wife in the north-west
title.zh: 尼日利亚退役将军及其妻子在西北部被绑架

summary.en: Maj Gen Rabe Abubakar and his wife were abducted in Nigeria's north-west, highlighting ongoing security issues in parts of the country.
summary.zh: 尼日利亚退役少将拉贝·阿布巴卡尔及其妻子在该国西北部被绑架，凸显了该国部分地区持续面临的安全挑战。

body.en:
A retired senior Nigerian military officer and his wife have been kidnapped by armed men in north-west Nigeria, the army has confirmed.

Maj Gen Rabe Abubakar, who had a high-profile job as military spokesman between 2015 and 2017, was abducted from his car on Saturday while travelling in Katsina state.

Efforts are now under way to rescue the couple and track down their captors, military spokesman Gen Michael Onoja told the BBC.

The kidnapping highlights the continuing security challenges facing parts of north-west Nigeria, where criminal gangs known locally as "bandits" frequently carry out kidnappings for ransom, as well as cattle rustling and attacks on rural communities.

Some militant jihadists have also operated in the region. An alleged militant camp in Sokoto state was the target of a US airstrike on 25 December last year.

Zamfara state, which neighbours both Katsina and Sokoto, has seen years of similar violence, with some communities previously attempting to make peace with armed groups, efforts that have largely failed to bring lasting stability.

The government has intensified actions to curb kidnapping, including introducing measures aimed at discouraging ransom payments. However, attacks have continued.

No group has said it was behind Saturday's abduction and the army is still waiting for the kidnappers to contact the family, the army said.

Local reports say the retired general was travelling to Katsina for a wedding when gunmen attacked his vehicle.

Abubakar's driver reportedly escaped despite being hit by gunfire, while the former military spokesman and his wife were taken away by the attackers into a nearby forested area.

The abduction comes days after another deadly attack in Katsina state. On Friday, armed men reportedly raided Kiliya village in Dutsinma Local Government Area, killing at least 16 people.

Residents said the attack happened shortly after Friday prayers, as people gathered to celebrate the Eid al-Adha holiday.

Security agencies had issued warnings about possible attacks during the celebrations, prompting some state governments to introduce measures aimed at limiting large public gatherings and strengthening security.
body.zh: 尼日利亚军队证实，一名退休高级尼日利亚军官和他的妻子在尼日利亚西北部被武装人员绑架。 拉贝·阿布巴卡尔少将于 2015 年至 2017 年期间担任军方发言人，周六在卡齐纳州旅行时从车内被绑架。 军方发言人迈克尔·奥诺亚将军告诉英国广播公司，目前正在努力营救这对夫妇并追查绑架者。 此次绑架事件凸显了尼日利亚西北部部分地区持续面临的安全挑战，当地被称为“土匪”的犯罪团伙经常进行绑架勒索赎金、偷牛和袭击农村社区的活动。 一些激进的圣战分子也在该地区活动。去年 12 月 25 日，美国空袭了索科托州的一个据称激进分子营地。 与卡齐纳州和索科托州相邻的扎姆法拉州多年来也发生过类似的暴力事件，一些社区此前曾试图与武装团体实现和平，但这些努力基本上未能带来持久稳定。 政府加强了遏制绑架的行动，包括采取旨在阻止支付赎金的措施。然而，袭击仍在继续。 军方表示，没有任何组织表示是周六绑架事件的幕后黑手，军方仍在等待绑匪与家人联系。 当地报道称，这位退休将军前往卡齐纳参加婚礼时，枪手袭击了他的车辆。 据报道，阿布巴卡尔的司机尽管遭到枪击，但还是逃脱了，而前军方发言人和他的妻子则被袭击者带到附近的森林地区。 这次绑架事件发生在卡齐纳州发生另一起致命袭击事件几天后。据报道，周五，武装人员袭击了杜辛马地方政府区的基利亚村，造成至少 16 人死亡。 居民表示，袭击发生在周五祈祷后不久，当时人们聚集在一起庆祝宰牲节假期。 安全机构已就庆祝活动期间可能发生的袭击发出警告，促使一些州政府采取旨在限制大型公众集会和加强安全的措施。

title.en: Laos cave survivors help with plan to find last two missing men
title.zh: 老挝洞穴幸存者帮助寻找最后两名失踪男子

summary.en: So far, five men have been freed from the narrow, flooded cave but efforts are ongoing to locate two more.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Some of those freed from a flooded cave in Laos are helping in efforts to find the last two missing men trapped inside, rescuers have said.

So far, five of the seven initially missing have been rescued but it is believed the remaining two men are trapped deeper inside the cave in the mountain area of central Xaysomboun province.

The men, all local villagers, entered the narrow tunnels on 20 May in search of gold but flash floods stopped them from leaving.

On Sunday, a rescuer told AFP that several survivors were giving advice from their hospital room on how to find the remaining men, including descriptions of the deeper part of the cave.

A Laotian rescue group said the men's information on the cave system - which extends deep underground and in some places measures around 50cm (20in) wide - was "considered substantial" and used in preparing a new search plan.

It comes as reports said the four men who left the cave on Saturday managed to free themselves without the help of rescuers after the water level lowered.

One unverified video posted to social media showed cheers from both rescuers and onlookers as the men emerged from the cave.

It was not clear what caused the water to lower, but a Japanese rescue diver told the Associated Press on Sunday that flood water was being drained from the cave.

Yoshitaka Isaji said the passage used in rescue efforts on Saturday was currently impassable because a drainage pump had broken, but repair efforts were ongoing.

Earlier in the week, a plan to pump out flood water from the tunnels also failed.

Specialist divers from other countries including Thailand, Indonesia, France and Australia are also helping the searches.
body.zh: 救援人员表示，从老挝一个被洪水淹没的洞穴中获救的一些人正在帮助寻找被困在里面的最后两名失踪男子。 到目前为止，最初失踪的七人中有五人已获救，但据信其余两人被困在赛宋本省中部山区的洞穴深处。 这些人都是当地村民，5 月 20 日进入狭窄的隧道寻找黄金，但山洪爆发阻止他们离开。 周日，一名救援人员告诉法新社，几名幸存者正在病房里就如何寻找剩余人员提供建议，包括对洞穴深处的描述。 老挝的一个救援组织表示，这些人提供的关于洞穴系统的信息“被认为是大量的”，并用于准备新的搜索计划。该洞穴系统深入地下，有些地方宽约 50 厘米（20 英寸）。 据报道，周六离开洞穴的四名男子在水位下降后在没有救援人员帮助的情况下成功逃脱。 社交媒体上发布的一段未经证实的视频显示，当这些人从洞穴中出来时，救援人员和旁观者都发出欢呼。 目前尚不清楚是什么原因导致水位下降，但一名日本救援潜水员周日告诉美联社，洪水正在从洞穴中排出。 Yoshitaka Isaji 表示，周六救援工作中使用的通道目前无法通行，因为排水泵坏了，但修复工作正在进行中。 本周早些时候，从隧道中抽出洪水的计划也失败了。 来自泰国、印度尼西亚、法国和澳大利亚等其他国家的专业潜水员也在帮助搜寻。

title.en: South Africa made to look like fools after World Cup visa issues, says minister
title.zh: 部长表示，世界杯签证问题后，南非看起来像个傻瓜

summary.en: The country's football association says it is working to resolve the problems that have delayed the team's departure to Mexico.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
South Africa's sports minister has demanded an explanation after the country's football team was delayed travelling to Mexico ahead of the World Cup due to visa issues.

The South African Football Association (Safa) admitted the team had "experienced challenges regarding Visas for some players and officials" but did not give further details. National broadcaster SABC described what happened as an "administrative bungle".

In response, sports minister Gayton McKenzie said he had told Safa: "I need a report and action must be taken against those responsible for this mess."

The team, nicknamed Bafana Bafana, are due to face Jamaica in a friendly in Mexico on Friday.

They will then play in the World Cup opening match against Mexico, which is co-hosting the competition alongside the US and Canada, on 11 June.

"This Safa travel & visa debacle is embarrassing & grossly unfair towards the players & coaching staff," McKenzie also wrote on X.

A brief statement from Safa said it was "working around the clock to ensure that the team travels to Mexico City as soon as possible ahead of the opening match".

According to South African news site TimesLive, efforts were being made to get the team US visas to allow the team to travel either later on Sunday or on Monday.

The Bafana Bafana squad and staff need permission to enter the US as they play their second World Cup game against the Czech Republic in Atlanta.

South Africa is one of 10 African nations taking part in the expanded 48-team World Cup.

The game against Jamaica will be Bafana Bafana's last chance to get ready for the tournament, which they last appeared at when South Africa hosted the finals in 2010.

Their final home match on Friday - a 0-0 draw against Nicaragua that included a missed South African penalty - was described in some reports as "disappointing" and extended their winless run to four games.
body.zh: 由于签证问题，南非足球队在世界杯之前推迟前往墨西哥，南非体育部长要求做出解释。 南非足协（Safa）承认球队“在一些球员和官员的签证方面遇到了挑战”，但没有提供更多细节。国家广播公司 SABC 将此次事件描述为“行政失误”。 对此，体育部长盖顿·麦肯齐表示，他已告诉萨法：“我需要一份报告，必须对那些应对这场混乱负责的人采取行动。” 这支绰号为“巴法纳·巴法纳”的球队将于周五在墨西哥与牙买加队进行一场友谊赛。 随后，他们将在 6 月 11 日对阵与美国和加拿大共同主办世界杯的墨西哥队进行世界杯揭幕战。 麦肯齐还在 X 上写道：“萨法的旅行和签证问题令人尴尬，对球员和教练组来说非常不公平。” 萨法的一份简短声明表示，“正在全天候工作，以确保球队在揭幕战前尽快前往墨西哥城”。 据南非新闻网站 TimesLive 报道，球队正在努力获得美国签证，以便球队可以在周日晚些时候或周一出发。 Bafana Bafana 球队和工作人员需要获得许可才能进入美国，因为他们将在亚特兰大对阵捷克共和国进行第二场世界杯比赛。 南非是参加扩大后的 48 队世界杯的 10 个非洲国家之一。 对阵牙买加的比赛将是巴法纳为世界杯做准备的最后机会，他们上次参加世界杯是在2010年南非主办决赛时。 他们周五的最后一场主场比赛——0-0战平尼加拉瓜，南非队错失点球——被一些报道描述为“令人失望”，并将他们的不胜场次延长至四场。

title.en: Brazil is set to cut in on China's rare earths dominance
title.zh: 巴西有望打破中国在稀土领域的主导地位

summary.en: Brazil is experiencing growing demand for its extensive rare earth element reserves. Major global mining companies are investing in Brazil, seeing it as a future leader in critical magnetic metals and an alternative to China's current market dominance.
summary.zh: 巴西对其丰富的稀土元素储量需求日益增长。全球主要矿业巨头正押注巴西，视其为关键磁性金属的下一个强国，并作为中国市场主导地位的替代选择。

body.en:
Brazil is seeing increasing demand for its vast reserves of rare earth elements. Global mining giants are betting on Brazil as the next powerhouse for critical magnetic metals and an alternative to China's dominance.

There is a new rush for resources taking shape in Brazil . But this time, it is not about gold, coffee or rubber. Instead, the focus is on the gold of the artificial intelligence and renewable energy era: rare earths .

"The next big, rare earth projects in the world will be in Brazil," the geologist Andrew Tunks, CEO of the Australian mining company Meteoric Resources, told DW. "I don't know how long it will take," Tunks said, "but I think in time [Brazil] will compete with China."

Meteoric is investing heavily in rare earth mining in Brazil. Its so-called Caldeira project, located in the state of Minas Gerais, is believed to be the world's largest ionic clay deposit.

Ionic clay deposits are among the most important sources of "medium" and "heavy" rare earths, such as dysprosium and terbium, which are essential for the high-performance magnets used in wind turbines and electric vehicles .

According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), "demand for magnet rare earth elements (neodymium, praseodymium, dysprosium and terbium) has doubled since 2015 and is set to expand further by a third by 2030 under today's policy settings, thanks to growing electrification and the rapid deployment of new energy technologies such as EVs and wind turbines."

The IEA says growing demand for automation, robotics and digital technologies will further boost the need for rare earths, which are essential for electric vehicles, AI data centers and advanced robotics.

Brazil holds the world's second-largest rare earth reserves after China, with estimated deposits of around 21 million tons. China remains far ahead, topping the global ranking with 44 million tons.

Rising global demand for rare earths has triggered an explosion in mining applications at Brazil's National Mining Agency (ANM). There are currently 2,758 projects under consideration.

For comparison, just over 250 applications for rare earth mining were filed in Brazil between 1975 and 2020. Between 2023 and 2024 alone, that number surged to 1,662.

Brazil's new "gold rush" is also being felt on the stock market. Share prices of companies investing in rare earth mining in the country have soared. Over the past 12 months, stocks in Meteoric (Australia), Resouro Strategic Metals (Canada), Appia Rare Earths and Uranium Corp (Canada), and USA Rare Earths (US) have risen between 65% and 122%.

In April, USA Rare Earths acquired Brazil's only active rare earth mine from the Brazilian mining company Serra Verde in Minacu, in the state of Goias, for $2.8 billion (€2.4 billion).

title.en: Israeli forces push further into Lebanon, capturing strategic mountain castle
title.zh: 以色列军队深入黎巴嫩，攻占战略山顶城堡

summary.en: Israeli forces have advanced further into Lebanon, successfully capturing a strategic mountain castle. This marks a significant military gain for Israel since the latest conflict with Hezbollah began in early March.
summary.zh: 以色列军队进一步深入黎巴嫩，攻占了一座具有战略意义的山顶城堡。这是自三月初以色列与真主党最新一轮冲突爆发以来，以色列取得的一项重大军事进展。

body.en:
Israeli troops have captured a strategic mountain topped with a Crusader-built castle in southern Lebanon, in their deepest incursion into the country in more than a quarter of a century.

The capture of Beaufort Castle near the city of Nabatiyeh came after days of intense fighting and airstrikes in nearby villages where Israeli troops fought Hezbollah members in the rugged area.

The capture of the castle marks a major gain for Israel since the latest Israel-Hezbollah war began in early March and as the two countries that have been in a state of war since Israel was created in 1948 hold direct talks in Washington.

The Israeli army's Arabic spokesman Avichay Adraee posted a photograph on X showing Israeli troops walking outside the castle.

Lebanon's state-run National News Agency (NNA) earlier reported Israeli airstrikes and artillery shelling near the Beaufort Castle, which is about 15km from the Israeli border and overlooks wide parts of southern Lebanon.

The castle was held by Israeli troops for 18 years until they withdrew from Lebanon in May 2000.

Israeli troops have been advancing for days in villages close to the castle, including Yohmor and Zawtar al-Sharqieh near the city of Nabatieh, after they crossed the strategic Litani River, which the Israeli military has used as a de facto boundary.

Lebanon's prime minister Nawaf Salam accused Israel on Saturday of pursuing a "scorched-earth policy and collective punishment" in the south, urging a halt to the fighting and warning it was "destroying towns and villages, and forcing their inhabitants into exile".

Military delegations from both countries held security talks in Washington on Friday, with more US-brokered negotiations planned next week.

Salam said the outcome of the negotiations was "not guaranteed", but called them "the least costly path for our country and our people".

A truce to halt the fighting between Israel and Tehran-backed Hezbollah officially began on 17 April, but has never been observed.

Both Israel and Hezbollah accuse each other daily of violating the ceasefire and justify their attacks by the other's alleged breaches.

A US statement issued after Friday's Israel-Lebanon talks made no mention of the truce, but said the "productive military-to-military discussions" would inform next week's political meeting.

Large areas to the south are under Israeli military control and aerial attacks have continued in recent days.

NNA reported Israeli airstrikes on different parts of southern Lebanon, including in the village of Ansar that killed three people.

title.en: Meteor explodes over United States, triggering sonic boom
title.zh: 流星在美国上空爆炸，引发音爆

summary.en: A meteor broke apart over the US state of Massachusetts. Several people reported that the buildings they were in shook during the incident.
summary.zh: 一颗流星在美国马萨诸塞州上空爆炸，引发音爆，并导致多栋建筑物震动。

body.en:
A meteor broke apart over the US state of Massachusetts. Several people reported that the buildings they were in shook during the incident.

A meteor hurtling toward  Earth's atmosphere exploded over the northeastern United States , causing a loud double boom that shook buildings in Massachusetts and Rhode Island, according to reports on Saturday.

The phenomenon released energy equivalent to about 300 tons of TNT, accounting for the loud noise, the US space agency,  NASA , wrote in a statement posted on X.

The meteor, measuring about 3 feet (nearly 1 meter) wide, entered the atmosphere around the New Hampshire border with Massachusetts, north of Boston, the Associated Press cited the American Meteor Society as saying.

The fireball fragmented over northeastern Massachusetts and southeastern New Hampshire at 2:06 pm (6:06 pm UTC), NASA deputy news chief Jennifer Dooren told news agency AFP.

She added that the meteor was traveling at 75,000 miles per hour (more than 120,000 kilometers per hour) when it broke apart at an altitude of 40 miles (64 kilometers) over the area.

"This fireball was not associated with any currently active meteor shower, but it was a natural object and not a re-entry of space debris or a satellite," Dooren said in her statement.

Some people took to social media to report that their houses shook from the noise.

In some videos circulating online, what sounded like two quick booms could be heard, with no sign of fire, smoke or any visible causes for the noise.

title.en: Socceroos suffer 1-0 defeat against Mexico in pre-World Cup friendly
title.zh: 澳大利亚足球队在世界杯热身赛中以0-1不敌墨西哥队

summary.en: Mexico completely dominated Australia in the opening half of the FIFA World Cup 2026 warm-up match, leading to a 1-0 defeat for the Socceroos.
summary.zh: 在2026年国际足联世界杯热身赛中，墨西哥队在上半场完全压制了澳大利亚队，最终澳大利亚足球队以0-1落败。

body.en:
The Socceroos have suffered a fiery 1-0 loss to FIFA World Cup 2026 co-hosts Mexico in the last game before coach Tony Popovic picks his squad for the tournament.

Australia were completely dominated by the world No.15 side in the opening half in front of a raucous crowd at the Rose Bowl stadium in Pasadena, California.

Despite a second-half recovery, the Socceroos were without any points on the board at full-time. Johan Vasquez's header in the 28th minute proved the difference, but Mohamed Toure should have equalised on the stroke of half-time.

Australia improved after the break, but the game erupted into an all-in scuffle after Mexico attempted to take a free kick quickly and thought they'd scored in the 76th minute — but it was called back.

A day before picking his squad on 1 June, Popovic named a largely experienced line-up, including Mathew Leckie and Harry Souttar's first starts since late 2024.

Fresh off defecting from Italy, Cristian Volpato unsurprisingly didn't make the squad, having only arrived in camp on Saturday morning, while Nestory Irankunda made a late cameo.

Back-up goalkeeper Joe Gauci, attacker Brandon Borrello, and uncapped striker Tete Yengi didn't make the 15-man bench.

Leckie started as an inverted right winger in his first game since November 2024, just his third appearance since the 2022 World Cup.

Souttar was in the starting back three in his first appearance since December 2024, alongside 18-year-old Lucas Herrington — who appears destined for his first World Cup — and Alessandro Circati.

Herrington, Souttar, Jordy Bos and Toure in flashes were among the bright sparks.

Souttar blocked a Vasquez shot inside the opening minute and it proved ominous as Mexico dominated the half.

In the seventh minute, Toure was incensed when he was brought down by Edson Alvarez but his pleas for a foul and card were ignored.

Jackson Irvine shot wide in the 15th minute and Mat Ryan brilliantly denied Alexis Vega in the 25th minute.

Mexico scored when Vega whipped in a corner and Vasquez ghosted in behind Aiden O'Neill, jumped and turned a bullet header on to the post that beat Ryan.

Toure should have scored in stoppage time when he pounced on a poor defensive header from Mateo Chavez Garcia and chipped wide of the open goal mouth.

The stadium was in raptures when legendary goalkeeper Guillermo Ochoa, headed to his fifth World Cup, entered the fray at halftime and three minutes later batted away O'Neill's fierce long-range strike.

title.en: Ukraine: IAEA seeks access to Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant after reported drone strike

summary.en: Russia has accused Ukraine of striking the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant with a drone, an accusation Ukraine denies. The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) is now seeking access to the facility to investigate the claims.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯声称乌克兰无人机袭击了扎波罗热核电站，乌克兰否认了这一指控。国际原子能机构（IAEA）目前正寻求进入该设施进行调查。

body.en:
Russia claims that a Ukrainian drone struck the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant. Ukraine has denied the accusation. The International Atomic Energy Agency has sought to examine the facility.

The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) has requested access to the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant in southeastern Ukraine after a reported drone strike on the Russian-occupied facility.

The UN nuclear watchdog said it was informed by the plant — currently under Kremlin-installed management — that a drone struck a turbine building in the complex, reportedly leaving a hole in its wall.

On Saturday, Russia's state nuclear energy company, Rosatom, claimed that a Ukrainian drone had hit the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant, which was captured by Russian forces ​in March 2022.

"This afternoon, a Ukrainian kamikaze combat drone ​struck the turbine hall building of Power Unit No. ​6, ‌resulting in a subsequent detonation," Rosatom chief Alexei Likhachev said in a statement, calling the incident "deliberate."

"The explosion caused no damage to the primary equipment; however, it ‌tore a hole in the turbine hall wall," he added.

Ukraine's military denied attacking the site, calling Moscow's claims "yet another propaganda ploy."

"Ukrainian servicemen act strictly within the international humanitarian law and are fully aware of the consequences ⁠of ​any actions targeting nuclear facilities," the military ​said in its statement.

"At the relevant section of the front line, there ​was no active fighting during ‌the incident, and no weapons were used," the statement added.

Zaporizhzhia is Europe's largest nuclear power plant. It has a capacity of nearly 6,000 megawatts and six reactors, all of which have been shut down for safety since it came under Russian control.

IAEA head ‌Rafael ​Grossi expressed serious concern about the reported incident, the agency said in a statement posted on X.

"Attacking nuclear sites is like playing with fire," it cited Grossi as saying and further added that an IAEA team at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant has requested access to "examine the affected turbine building first-hand." 

The agency said it would be the first drone attack within the plant site's perimeter since April 2024.

title.en: Drones and second-hand submarines: US 'grateful' for Australia as latest AUKUS details unveiled
title.zh: 无人机和二手潜艇：最新 AUKUS 细节公布后，美国对澳大利亚表示“感谢”

summary.en: The US has again demanded its allies step up their military budgets at a high-level international defence meeting in Singapore.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
All nuclear-powered submarines Australia will receive under the AUKUS military pact will be second-hand, Defence Minister Richard Marles has revealed.

Australia had been expecting to receive two used submarines and one new one but now plans for all three to be in-service vessels from the United States Navy.

Speaking at a high-level gathering of military and defence leaders in Singapore on Sunday, Marles said the new approach would be "cost-effective" and "streamline" the delivery of the Virginia-class submarines.

It comes after US defence secretary Pete Hegseth told SBS News that the country is "grateful" for Australian support while warning that other allies need to step up their military spending as he outlined the US' vision for Indo-Pacific security.

In a joint statement with his US and UK counterparts, Marles said the "seabed is a battlefield" as he announced a shift in focus from pillar one of the AUKUS deal to pillar two. The first phase's nuclear-powered submarines will be supported by second-phase underwater drones designed to protect underwater infrastructure like internet cables.

"The Deputy Prime Minister and Secretaries welcomed the proposed approach to streamline Australia's acquisition of Virginia-class submarines (VCS), simplifying supply chain management, operational and maintenance requirements, and maximising cost efficiencies," Marles said in a statement about the second-hand submarines.

"This approach would enable Australia to acquire three in-service VCS in lieu of a mixture of new and in-service VCS variants."

The US defence leader emphasised the need for a "durable balance of power" in the Pacific to counter Chinese influence during his Saturday speech at the International Institute for Strategic Studies Shangri-La Dialogue, which brings together top defence officials and experts from about 45 countries.

"The era of the United States subsidising the defence of wealthy nations is over. We need partners, not protectorates. We seek alliances built on shared responsibility, not dependency," Hegseth said.

"For those who continue to free-ride on the generosity of the American taxpayer, hear us now: those days are over. Allies that refuse to stand up and carry their weight for our collective defence will face a clear shift in how we do business," he added later.

Last month, US President Donald Trump said he was "not happy with Australia" over its perceived failure to come to their aid in opening the Strait of Hormuz — a key strategic blow the US has suffered during its conflict with Iran, which continues to cause havoc to global shipping.

title.en: Venezuela opposition candidate Gonzalez urges new elections
title.zh: 委内瑞拉反对派候选人冈萨雷斯呼吁举行新选举

summary.en: Venezuelan former opposition candidate Edmundo Gonzalez Urrutia has called for fresh presidential elections in the country. This appeal follows the capture of former President Nicolas Maduro by US forces approximately five months prior.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉前反对派候选人埃德蒙多·冈萨雷斯·乌鲁蒂亚呼吁在该国举行新的总统选举。此次呼吁是在美国军队逮捕前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗大约五个月后发出的。

body.zh: 前反对派候选人埃德蒙多·冈萨雷斯·乌鲁蒂亚呼吁委内瑞拉举行新的总统选举。大约五个月前，美军在突袭总统官邸时抓获了尼古拉斯·马杜罗。 76 岁的前外交官埃德蒙多·冈萨雷斯·乌鲁蒂亚 (Edmundo Gonzalez Urrutia) 被一些国家视为 2024 年大选的获胜者，他周六表示，委内瑞拉应该举行新的总统选举，并支持诺贝尔和平奖获得者、反对派领袖玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多 (Maria Corina Machado)。 在社交媒体上发布的视频消息中，冈萨雷斯表达了对反对派领袖马查多的声援，马查多也主张举行新的选举。 冈萨雷斯说：“几天前在巴拿马，玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多和委内瑞拉的民主力量为了一个目标走到了一起：委内瑞拉的自由。我们站在一起，在同一个路线图上团结起来，朝着同一个命运迈进。” 他补充说：“我的承诺是尽我所能，确保授权成为真正的自由、真正的民主。” 冈萨雷斯表示，选举过程应该有“独立裁判”、政治多元化以及国内和国际观察员。他说，现在是“为举行总统选举创造条件，作为公民变革的工具”的时候了。 马查多周六称赞冈萨雷斯是“为祖国服务和奉献的典范”。 马查多在社交媒体平台X上写道：“自由和繁荣的委内瑞拉已经重生，我亲爱的埃德蒙多，你的名字已经铭刻在它的心里。” 马杜罗此后被代理总统德尔西·罗德里格斯取代，后者似乎更愿意默许华盛顿的要求，例如改善美国获得委内瑞拉庞大石油供应的机会。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对罗德里格斯迄今为止的合作感到高兴，并且没有采取进一步行动来取代她的领导地位。 居住在西班牙的 76 岁前外交官冈萨雷斯在 2024 年总统选举中与马杜罗对峙。 马杜罗政府已向冈萨雷斯发出逮捕令，罪名是犯罪团伙和串谋有争议的选举。 马查多也被委内瑞拉政府视为逃犯。 尽管官方结果显示马杜罗赢得了 2024 年的竞选，但卡特中心和自由之家等外部选举观察员和监督机构发现结果缺乏可信度，选举过程也存在违规行为。 美国等一些国家已承认冈萨雷斯为 2024 年比赛的获胜者。

reflection.en: The call for new elections in Venezuela highlights the deep human desire for just and accountable leadership. When leaders govern with integrity, societies can flourish, but when governance is perceived as unjust, people often long for change. This aspiration for righteous rule reflects a universal hope for peace and well-being within a nation.
reflection.zh: 委内瑞拉呼吁举行新选举，凸显了人类对公正和负责任领导的深切渴望。当领导者以正直治理时，社会才能繁荣；但当治理被视为不公时，人们往往渴望改变。这种对公义统治的向往，反映了国家内部对和平与福祉的普遍希望。

title.en: Trump says he will headline US birthday event himself after artists drop out

summary.en: Several musical performers scheduled to appear in the US national birthday celebration have cancelled their appearances, citing concerns about its association with the US president. The president has stated he will now headline the event himself.

body.en:
US President Donald Trump, claiming he could draw larger audiences than Elvis Presley, said overnight he was considering headlining a Washington rally after several artists quit events celebrating the country's 250th anniversary.

Shortly after they were announced as performers in a concert series around the 4 July holiday, several musical acts backed out, with some citing politicisation of the event.

The concerts were scheduled to kick off on 25 June as part of a major exposition on the National Mall organised by Freedom 250, a Trump-backed public-private entity.

"I understand Artists are getting 'the yips'" about performing, Trump posted on Truth Social, one day after a fourth and fifth act announced their departure, out of a total of nine artists originally announced.

"So I am thinking about bringing the Number One Attraction anywhere in the World, the man who gets much larger audiences than Elvis in his prime ... and the man who some say is the Greatest President in History (THE GOAT!), DONALD J. TRUMP, to take the place of these highly paid, Third Rate 'Artists.'"

Trump said he was ordering aides to assess "the feasibility of doing an AMERICA IS BACK Rally on Wednesday" on the mall, where he would deliver a speech "rallying the Country forward like I have done ever since being President!"

The Republican leader did not specify which Wednesday he was eyeing, nor did he describe which events his rally was meant to supersede.

The statement came a day after multiple artists, including country singer Martina McBride and glam rocker Bret Michaels, frontman of 1980s band Poison, said they were dropping out of the White House-backed concert series.

"Unfortunately, what was presented to us as a celebration of our country has evolved into something much more divisive than what I agreed to be a part of," Michaels posted on social media.

Trump has openly tried to stamp his mark on the celebrations, most notably by staging an ultra-violent mixed martial arts fight in a specially constructed arena on the White House lawn on 14 June — his 80th birthday.

In a country that regularly produces many of the world's biggest global stars, the remaining line-up of artists whose prime came and went decades ago — such as Vanilla Ice and C+C Music Factory — has sparked a flood of sarcastic comments on social media.

The concerts were planned as the opening ceremony of the Great American State Fair, a 16-day event running from 25 June to 10 July.

body.en:
Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi has strongly rejected China's claim that Japan is moving toward “neo-militarism.” He accused Beijing of rapidly arming itself.

Japan's Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi has slammed China for bolstering its military capabilities "without sufficient transparency."

Koizumi's comments came as he spoke at the annual Shangri-La Dialogue in Singapore on Sunday.

The minister said China continued to expand defense spending at a high level and the country's military activities were a matter of "serious concern" for Japan and and the international community.

Ties between the Asian countries have been at their worst in years ever since Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi cautioned in November that if China were to attack  Taiwan — the self-governing democratic island that China claims as its territory — Japan could intervene.

Under Takaichi, Japan has been  strengthening its domestic arms industry and fostering deeper ties with its defense partners in a pivot from the pacifist principles that shaped its security policy following World War II .

Earlier in May, China's Foreign Ministry urged Asia-Pacific nations to be vigilant and "jointly resist" what it called "the reckless actions of Japan's neo-militarism."

Koizumi on Sunday dismissed accusations from China that Japan was embracing such a policy.

"Think about it. There is a country that has a huge arsenal of nuclear weapons and strategic bombers," Koizumi said, without naming China.

"Japan has neither of such weapons. And, yet, Japan is labeled 'new militarism.' Isn't it strange?" he said.

But Major General Meng Xiangqing, China's delegate at the forum in Singapore, railed against Japan.

"I deeply doubt whether ‌a ​country that has not thoroughly eradicated the toxic legacy of militarism is qualified to talk extensively about defense cooperation on international occasions, and whether it can win the trust of the international community, especially the Asian countries it once invaded," he said.

Koizumi said Japan would "steadily build up its defense capabilities and make continuous updates with a high degree of transparency," including in the areas of artificial intelligence, uncrewed systems, along with cyber and space defense.

Tokyo, he said, is "determined" to play a ⁠new role in enhancing defense cooperation in the Asia-Pacific and boosting deterrence in the region.

"Japan's past as a peace-loving nation has been valued by the region and by the international community. This fact will not be shaken by false claims, because it is a fact," he said.

body.en:
Japan's defence minister has rebutted Beijing's claim that his country was engaging in a "new militarism" - criticising China for its military expansion and lack of transparency.

Shinjiro Koizumi argued it was actually China and its "huge arsenal" of weapons that was of "serious concern" to the international community.

His remarks, on the last day of a defence summit in Singapore, were some of the most pointed yet from Tokyo in response to China's repeated criticism of Japan's military build-up under Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.

The two countries have a long history of tensions stemming from Japan's invasion of China during World War Two.

Last week, a day before the Singapore summit began, China's national defence ministry spokesman Jiang Bin had warned "the grey rhino of a remilitarised Japan is gathering speed" and called on the international community to "work together to contain Japan's neo-militarism".

Japan has been steadily increasing its defence budget, setting spending records for 12 consecutive years. Its latest budget, approved in December by its cabinet, is for more than 9 trillion yen ($57bn; £42bn) - moving the country closer to its target of spending 2% of its GDP on the military.

The Japanese government has previously insisted it was not seeking war and only wants to bolster its defences.

In his speech on Sunday at the Shangri-la Dialogue, Koizumi said it was "only natural" that every country, including Japan, updates its defences to meet new challenges and to contribute to peace in the region.

He sought to reassure the roomful of officials from Asian countries, including several that were invaded by Japan in WW2, by promising Japan would proceed "with a high degree of transparency" and engage in constant dialogue with other countries.

"What are we developing these capabilities for? And based on what thinking? Japan will move forward while making a clear explanation to the international community," he said.

Koizumi rebuffed the idea that Japan was engaged in "new militarism", saying it was "nothing further from the truth".

"There's a country that has a huge arsenal of nuclear weapons and strategic bombers," he said, in a veiled reference to China. "Japan has neither of these weapons. And yet Japan is labelled [with] 'new militarism'. Isn't it strange?"

Following his speech, a representative of the Chinese military asked whether Japan would issue an apology to China, South Korea and South East Asian victims in WW2.

"China continues to increase its defence spending at a high level and is rapidly expanding its military capabilities across a wide range of areas without sufficient transparency," he said.

body.en: Twin threats from east and west have clearly made the bloc more appealing – but its rule-bound institutions need urgent attention Giant butter mountains, wine lakes and an apocryphal EU ban on bendy bananas formed the mythological backdrop to Britain’s 2016 Brexit referendum debacle. Yet while many Vote Leave claims were exaggerated, inaccurate or blatantly untrue, the EU’s capacity for laying itself open to ridicule is undiminished 10 years on. Take the strange case of the whingeing EU commissioners, annoyed that their officially provided electric vehicles cannot manage the time-consuming 280-mile journey between Brussels and Strasbourg without stopping to recharge. This important issue, first reported by Politico , raises vital questions. Do these highly paid bureaucrats really need chauffeur-driven “company cars”? Surely they could catch a train, or fly, or cycle. EV use is mandatory for road trips. The vehicles are supplied in line with the EU’s Green Deal emissions-cutting policy, which commissioners might be expected to support, not carp about. So why is the commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, allowed a petrol engine? The biggest question of all is why make these tedious Brussels-Strasbourg journeys in the first place? title.en: Shangri-La Dialogue: Hegseth says 'no state, including China,' must dominate Asia
title.zh: 香格里拉对话：赫格塞思称“包括中国在内，任何国家”都不得主导亚洲

summary.en: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth voiced concerns over China's military expansion in Asia during the Shangri-La Dialogue. He also urged Asian allies and partners to raise their defense spending to 3.5% of their GDP.
summary.zh: 美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞思在香格里拉对话期间对中国在亚洲的军事集结表示担忧。他还表示，美国期望其在亚洲的盟友和伙伴将国防开支增加到其GDP的3.5%。

body.en:
US Defense Secretary of Pete Hegseth expressed alarm about China's military buildup in Asia. He also said the United States expects its allies and partners in Asia to increase defense spending to 3.5% of their GDP.

In his speech Saturday at the Shangri-La Dialogue in  Singapore , Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth outlined US foreign policy goals for Asia.

Hegseth told the defense summit that the United States seeks a "stable equilibrium" in Asia. He added that no country — including China — should be able to establish unquestioned dominance over the region.

"What we seek ... is a genuinely stable equilibrium that works for Americans as well as our allies — a favorable but durable balance of power in which no state, including China, can impose its hegemony and hold the security or prosperity of our nation and our allies in question," the Pentagon chief said.

Hegseth said there was "rightful alarm" about China's military buildup across the Pacific region, but stressed that Washington does not seek "needless confrontation in the region."

"When we look across the region today, there is rightful alarm regarding China's historic military buildup and the expansion of its military activities in the region and beyond," Hegseth said.

Hegseth stressed that ties with Beijing are "better than they have been in many years," citing the increased number of military-to-military interactions as an example.

Richard Walker, DW's chief international editor, noted that Taiwan was not mentioned once in Hegseth's speech. When asked about the  paused arms sale deal with Taiwan , the Pentagon chief answered that the decision would rest with President Donald Trump .

The defense secretary also said the US expects its Asian allies and partners to increase defense spending to 3.5% of their GDPs.

"The era of ⁠the United States ​subsidizing the defense of wealthy nations is over... We need partners, not protectorates," he said. "We don't have a strong alliance unless everyone has skin in the game. No freeloading."

Since returning to the office, Trump has demanded that US allies, particularly NATO countries, increase their defense spending and reduce their reliance on Washington.

Hegseth also stressed that the United States has more than sufficient stockpiles of weapons and is "more than capable" of resuming the war with Iran.

Georg Mattes, the DW Asia Pacific bureau chief, said the key phrase in Hegseth's speech was that there is less need for the Shangri-La Dialogue and more need for a military buildup and deterrence. Mattes added, "I think that is a bit unsettling scenario for Southeastern Asians."

The Shangri-La Dialogue brings together top defense officials and experts from around 45 countries. The summit...
body.zh: 美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯对中国在亚洲的军力建设表示担忧。他还表示，美国预计其亚洲盟友和合作伙伴将国防开支增加至GDP的3.5%。 国防部长皮特·赫格斯周六在新加坡香格里拉对话会上发表讲话，概述了美国对亚洲的外交政策目标。 赫格斯在防务峰会上表示，美国寻求亚洲的“稳定平衡”。他补充说，包括中国在内的任何国家都不应该能够在该地区建立无可争议的主导地位。 五角大楼负责人说：“我们寻求的是一种真正稳定的平衡，对美国和我们的盟友都有利——一种有利但持久的力量平衡，在这种平衡中，包括中国在内的任何国家都不能强行霸权，并影响我们国家和盟友的安全或繁荣。” 赫格斯表示，对中国在太平洋地区的军事集结感到“合理的警惕”，但强调华盛顿并不寻求“在该地区进行不必要的对抗”。 赫格斯说：“当我们今天放眼整个地区时，我们对中国历史性的军事建设及其在该地区及其他地区的军事活动的扩张感到合理的警惕。” 赫格斯强调，与北京的关系“比多年来任何时候都好”，并以军队间互动次数的增加为例。 德国之声首席国际编辑理查德·沃克指出，赫格斯的演讲中一次也没有提到台湾。当被问及暂停对台军售协议时，五角大楼负责人回答说，决定权将由唐纳德·特朗普总统决定。 这位国防部长还表示，美国期望其亚洲盟友和合作伙伴将国防开支增加至国内生产总值的 3.5%。 “美国资助富裕国家国防的时代已经结束……我们需要合作伙伴，而不是保护国，”他说。 “除非每个人都参与其中，否则我们就没有一个强大的联盟。不要贪图便宜。” 自重返办公室以来，特朗普一直要求美国盟国，特别是北约国家增加国防开支，减少对华盛顿的依赖。 赫格斯还强调，美国拥有足够的武器库存，“完全有能力”恢复与伊朗的战争。 德国之声亚太分社社长格奥尔格·马特斯表示，赫格斯演讲的关键词是，不再需要香格里拉对话，而更需要军事集结和威慑。马特斯补充道：“我认为这对东南亚人来说有点令人不安。” 香格里拉对话会汇聚了来自约 45 个国家的高级防务官员和专家。峰会...

title.en: New Chinese surveillance leaves foreigners nowhere to hide
title.zh: 中国新监控系统让外国人无处藏身

summary.en: A Chinese cybersecurity expert has disclosed details of China's advanced high-tech policing system to DW. This system uses facial recognition at ski resorts and tracks individuals on trains, compiling comprehensive "holistic profiles" that leave foreigners with no place to hide.
summary.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声透露了中国新型高科技警务的细节。该系统利用滑雪场的面部识别和火车上的追踪，可以追踪任何人并建立“综合档案”，让外国人无处藏身。

body.en:
A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."

When a cybersecurity researcher known by the pseudonym NetAskari recently clicked on a tab labeled "Inquiry for journalist files" on an unsecured Chinese web dashboard, he expected to see a jumble of auto-generated mock data.

Instead, familiar faces popped up on the screen. It was a comprehensive database of almost every foreign journalist based in Beijing around 2021, including official passport photos taken at the entry/exit bureau, private cellphone numbers, visa details and dates of birth. He also found his own exact personal information lying dormant on this Chinese police watch list.

"It was more interesting than shocking," NetAskari told DW. "When you work as a journalist in China , you basically assume you are always on their radar. But what surprised me was simply how easy it was to access this highly sensitive system."

What NetAskari had stumbled upon is part modern China's emerging system of "holographic profiles."

He had unwittingly accessed a demonstration version of a remote tracking system designed for the Public Security Bureau in Zhangjiakou, the Hebei province city that hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics.

Though it was only a test panel, it was populated with real datasets, clearly outlining the trajectory of China's state surveillance machine, which is rapidly evolving from a network of simple street cameras into a data-fused, 24/7, predictive social control behemoth.

For years, China has operated the world's most extensive CCTV network. A massive initiative known as the "Xueliang" (Bright Eyes) project aims to merge these isolated islands of surveillance spread across the country.

But the data on the Zhangjiakou police dashboard shows the granular detail with which authorities can track an individual.

This system no longer relies solely on police cameras on street corners; it accurately records the specific train carriage and seat number a target occupies when arriving from Beijing or Shanghai, for example.

It even synchronizes photos taken by facial-recognition ticket gates at local ski resorts directly into its tracking mechanism. The movements of the researcher's acquaintances who recently skied in Zhangjiakou were precisely flagged and mapped out with detailed trajectories in the system.

"The idea is simply to process as much data as possible from as many sensors as possible in real time," the researcher noted.

The system logs daily behaviors like gasoline consumption, regular shopping locations and whether an individual frequently visits "petition areas."

body.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声透露了中国新型高科技警务的细节。从滑雪场面部识别到火车座位，该系统可以跟踪任何人并编制“整体档案”。 当一位化名 NetAskari 的网络安全研究人员最近点击一个不安全的中文网络仪表板上标有“查询记者档案”的选项卡时，他预计会看到一堆自动生成的模拟数据。 取而代之的是，熟悉的面孔出现在屏幕上。这是一个综合数据库，包含 2021 年左右驻京的几乎所有外国记者，包括在出入境局拍摄的官方护照照片、私人手机号码、签证详细信息和出生日期。他还发现自己的确切个人信息隐藏在这份中国警方的监视名单上。 “这比令人震惊更有趣，”内特阿斯卡里告诉德国之声。 “当你在中国担任记者时，你基本上会认为你总是在他们的监视范围内。但令我惊讶的是访问这个高度敏感的系统是多么容易。” NetAskari 偶然发现的是现代中国新兴的“全息轮廓”系统的一部分。 他无意中访问了为主办 2022 年冬季奥运会的河北省张家口市公安局设计的远程跟踪系统演示版本。 虽然它只是一个测试面板，但它填充了真实的数据集，清楚地概述了中国国家监控机器的轨迹，该机器正在从简单的街道摄像头网络迅速演变为数据融合的、24/7、预测性的社会控制庞然大物。 多年来，中国运营着世界上最广泛的闭路电视网络。一项名为“雪亮”（明亮的眼睛）项目的大规模倡议旨在合并这些分布在全国各地的监视孤岛。 但张家口警方仪表板上的数据显示了当局可以追踪个人的详细信息。 该系统不再仅仅依赖于街角的警察摄像头；例如，它可以准确记录目标从北京或上海抵达时所乘坐的具体火车车厢和座位号。 它甚至将当地滑雪场的面部识别检票口拍摄的照片直接同步到其跟踪机制中。研究人员最近在张家口滑雪的熟人的动作被精确标记，并在系统中绘制出详细的轨迹。 研究人员指出：“这个想法只是实时处理来自尽可能多的传感器的尽可能多的数据。” 该系统会记录日常行为，例如汽油消耗、常规购物地点以及个人是否经常访问“请愿区”。 这种大规模的数据融合工作......

reflection.en: The news of pervasive high-tech surveillance highlights the vulnerability of individuals when state power becomes absolute. Proverbs 28:15 reminds us that unchecked authority can be like a dangerous predator to a helpless populace. It calls us to reflect on the importance of freedom and the dignity of every person, even in the face of overwhelming systems.
reflection.zh: 普遍存在的高科技监控新闻凸显了当国家权力变得绝对时，个人所面临的脆弱性。箴言28:15提醒我们，不受约束的权力对无助的民众来说，可能像危险的捕食者。它呼吁我们反思自由的重要性以及每个人的尊严，即使面对压倒性的系统。

title.en: Can the Quad stay relevant to boost Indo-Pacific security?
title.zh: 四方安全对话能否保持相关性以促进印太安全？

summary.en: Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.
summary.zh: 美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚四国外长——统称为“四方安全对话”——需要搁置过去的分歧，才能使该联盟继续成为对抗中国的有效手段。

body.en:
Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.

Foreign ministers from the United States , India, Japan and Australia — the four nations that make up the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, better known as the Quad — are set to meet in New Delhi over three days startng Sunday to discuss Indo-Pacific security, energy supplies and emerging technologies.

The meeting comes as China continues to test geopolitical and security boundaries in the region.

But it's another issue, which is not on the agenda, that looms large over the gathering: how to keep the alliance alive and relevant in an ever more challenging geopolitical landscape and an increasingly assertive China .

The Quad, which unites the four nations in seeking a Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP), has not had a meeting of national leaders since 2024, when then-President Joe Biden hosted his counterparts in Wilmington, Delaware.

India was meant to host the next annual meeting in the latter part of 2025, but that never materialized amid tensions between India and the new administration of President Donald Trump .

Trump has imposed tariffs and punitive duties on Indian imports to the US, straining ties with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The US president further antagonized New Delhi by claiming to have mediated a settlement to border clashes between India and Pakistan in May last year . The US president was also critical of India purchasing Russian military equipment .

One year on, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is heading the US delegation to India, is tasked with smoothing ruffled diplomatic feathers. With Trump's attention apparently focused on the war in the Middle East and, potentially, Cuba , Rubio's mission could be a challenging one.

"The US, Japan and Australia already had an important and effective trilateral security arrangement, but the whole purpose of the Quad was to bring India in as another power to give it more influence and reach," said James Brown, a professor of international relations at the Tokyo campus of Temple University.

"Unfortunately, this US administration does not seem to have grasped that or valued India's presence as an ally, which has badly alienated Modi," he told DW.

Japan and Australia have made efforts to keep the four-way alliance intact and functioning, with Brown suggesting that the Quad might actually benefit from the US being represented by Rubio, rather than Trump, in India.

body.zh: 如果该联盟要继续成为对抗中国的有效手段，美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚（统称为“四方”）的外交部长就需要将过去的分歧抛在脑后。 来自美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚这四个国家的外交部长将于周日开始在新德里举行为期三天的会议，讨论印太安全、能源供应和新兴技术。 这次会议召开之际，中国正在继续测试该地区的地缘政治和安全边界。 但另一个未列入议程的问题在这次会议上显得尤为突出：如何在日益具有挑战性的地缘政治格局和日益自信的中国中保持联盟的活力和相关性。 四方联盟将四个国家团结起来，寻求自由开放的印度太平洋地区 (FOIP)，自 2024 年时任总统乔·拜登在特拉华州威尔明顿接待各国领导人以来，该组织就没有举行过国家领导人会议。 印度原定于 2025 年下半年主办下一次年度会议，但由于印度与唐纳德·特朗普总统新政府之间的紧张关系，这一目标从未实现。 特朗普对印度输美产品征收关税和惩罚性关税，导致与印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的关系紧张。这位美国总统去年五月声称已通过调解解决了印度和巴基斯坦之间的边境冲突，这进一步激怒了新德里。美国总统还批评印度购买俄罗斯军事装备。 一年后，率领美国代表团访问印度的国务卿马可·卢比奥肩负着平息外交争端的任务。由于特朗普的注意力显然集中在中东战争以及可能的古巴战争上，卢比奥的任务可能是一项具有挑战性的任务。 天普大学东京校区国际关系学教授詹姆斯·布朗表示：“美国、日本和澳大利亚已经达成了重要且有效的三边安全安排，但四方机制的全部目的是让印度成为另一个大国，以赋予其更大的影响力和影响力。” 他告诉德国之声：“不幸的是，本届美国政府似乎没有认识到这一点，也没有重视印度作为盟友的存在，这严重疏远了莫迪。” 日本和澳大利亚一直在努力保持四方联盟的完整和运作，布朗表示，四方联盟实际上可能会受益于卢比奥而不是特朗普在印度代表美国。 南加州大学教授德里克·格罗斯曼在《外交政策》杂志上撰文警告说，如果特朗普拒绝参加下一次领导人会议，可能会……

reflection.en: The Quad alliance's effectiveness in boosting regional security hinges on its members overcoming past differences and working together. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that where there is an abundance of wise counsel, there is safety. For nations, as for individuals, unity in purpose among leaders can lead to greater stability and protection for all.

title.en: Devastating storm set to move across Australia after leaving thousands in WA without power
title.zh: 破坏性风暴横扫澳大利亚，西澳数千户家庭断电

summary.en: A powerful "once in five-year" storm, bringing winds of up to 125km/ph, is moving across Australia after leaving thousands in Western Australia without power.
summary.zh: 一场五年一遇的强风暴正以高达每小时125公里的风速横扫澳大利亚，此前已导致西澳大利亚州数千户家庭断电。

body.en:
A powerful storm system that has pounded Perth's coastline, leaving thousands of homes without power, is set to move east across the country, with authorities warning the worst is still to come.

Damaging winds, heavy rain, thunderstorms, and large waves would continue to impact the south-west of Australia on Sunday and Monday, before the storm system moved into the southern and south-eastern parts of the country, the Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) said in an update.

Residents in the state's southwest were urged to close their curtains and remain inside, away from windows, as the low-pressure system approached.

"People should definitely tie down loose items like outdoor furniture and trampolines," BoM duty forecaster Luke Huntington told the Australian Associated Press.

"When those strong winds are coming through, make sure you stay inside and just stay off the roads, in case of fallen power lines or trees."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Winds of up to 125 km/ph were forecast on Sunday afternoon across the southwest, from Lancelin to Albany, including the city of Perth itself.

"This situation definitely doesn't happen every year and the wind is going to be the worst hazard," Huntington said.

A severe weather warning is in place across the entire south-west coast up to Kalgoorlie and Kalbarri.

The Department of Fire and Emergency Services has issued a separate "prepare to take shelter" warning across the entire southern quarter of the state.

"This is a prolonged severe weather event and conditions may change quickly," it said. "Rarely experienced winds may bring down trees, branches and powerlines and may cause loose items and debris to become airborne."

Severe weather warnings are also in place across much of southern South Australia and southern and eastern parts of Victoria, with damaging winds expected through Monday.

A cold front is driving across the country, pushed by two "particularly deep" low-pressure systems that are typically only seen once every few years, the BoM said.

"This low pressure system will move into the Bight, as well as this cold front, moving into South Australia, Victoria, New South Wales, and Tasmania through Monday and Tuesday," the BoM said.

"That means that our windy conditions, as well as shower and thunderstorm activities, will track through the southern and south-eastern parts of the country over the next few days."

Around 8,000 homes in the South West of WA and approximately 2,000 in the Perth metropolitan areas have been affected by power outages, according to Western Power.

The company has said that they expect to restore services to most affected customers by Sunday afternoon.

title.en: Drones and second-hand submarines: US 'grateful' for Australia as latest AUKUS details unveiled
title.zh: 无人机和二手潜艇：最新 AUKUS 细节公布后，美国对澳大利亚表示“感谢”

summary.en: The US has again demanded its allies step up their military budgets at a high-level international defence meeting in Singapore.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
All nuclear-powered submarines Australia will receive under the AUKUS military pact will be second-hand, Defence Minister Richard Marles has revealed.

Australia had been expecting to receive two used submarines and one new one but now plans for all three to be in-service vessels from the United States Navy.

Speaking at a high-level gathering of military and defence leaders in Singapore on Sunday, Marles said the new approach would be "cost-effective" and "streamline" the delivery of the Virginia-class submarines.

It comes after US defence secretary Pete Hegseth told SBS News that the country is "grateful" for Australian support while warning that other allies need to step up their military spending as he outlined the US' vision for Indo-Pacific security.

In a joint statement with his US and UK counterparts, Marles said the "seabed is a battlefield" as he announced a shift in focus from pillar one of the AUKUS deal to pillar two. The first phase's nuclear-powered submarines will be supported by second-phase underwater drones designed to protect underwater infrastructure like internet cables.

"The Deputy Prime Minister and Secretaries welcomed the proposed approach to streamline Australia's acquisition of Virginia-class submarines (VCS), simplifying supply chain management, operational and maintenance requirements, and maximising cost efficiencies," Marles said in a statement about the second-hand submarines.

"This approach would enable Australia to acquire three in-service VCS in lieu of a mixture of new and in-service VCS variants."

The US defence leader emphasised the need for a "durable balance of power" in the Pacific to counter Chinese influence during his Saturday speech at the International Institute for Strategic Studies Shangri-La Dialogue, which brings together top defence officials and experts from about 45 countries.

"The era of the United States subsidising the defence of wealthy nations is over. We need partners, not protectorates. We seek alliances built on shared responsibility, not dependency," Hegseth said.

"For those who continue to free-ride on the generosity of the American taxpayer, hear us now: those days are over. Allies that refuse to stand up and carry their weight for our collective defence will face a clear shift in how we do business," he added later.

title.en: 'They represent an era': Why football tracksuits are more than just kits
title.zh: “它们代表一个时代”：为什么足球运动服不仅仅是球衣

summary.en: The article explores how football tracksuits serve as significant cultural anchors for some migrants, helping them maintain a connection to their homeland and heritage while living abroad.

body.en:

When Neal Corcoran migrated to Australia from Ireland in 1991, what he missed most — apart from his family — was football.

Just a year earlier, Ireland had reached the quarter-finals of the FIFA World Cup for the first time in the nation's history, a run that remains one of the country's defining sporting moments.

"When I left Ireland, we were at our peak in our football journey," Corcoran tells SBS Japanese.

Growing up as a "football mad kid" in Dublin, he remembers arriving in Australia as a culture shock.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

At the time, football occupied a far smaller place in Australia's sporting landscape than it does today. The game was largely sustained by migrant communities through local clubs and the former National Soccer League (NSL), while mainstream attention remained fixed on Australian rules football, rugby league and cricket.

To preserve those memories, he kept the outfit he arrived in as an 11-year-old — an Ireland O'Neills 'Italia 90' tracksuit. More than clothing, it carries memories of family, identity and the euphoria surrounding Ireland's historic World Cup run.

Three decades later, that tracksuit has become the starting point for a much larger story: how sport can help migrants maintain connections to home, build community and find belonging in a new country.

Now an outreach worker helping vulnerable youth — sometimes using football as a tool for reintegration — Corcoran spends weekends travelling across the country in his collection of nostalgic tracksuits, connecting with people who find meaning in them.

"That jersey I have from 1993, someone remembers being 13 with their dad at the game. It brings you back to that era," he says.

His Instagram page, with 10.7k followers, reflects his desire to share the stories attached to the tracksuits.

From the iconic kit when it won the 1994 World Cup in the US, to a replica of the Argentina shirt Diego Maradona wore when he scored his 'Hand of God' goal in 1986, not to mention Iraq's incredibly rare Olympic tracksuit, there are over 50 unique pieces in his collection.

More recently, he has also developed an interest in historic pieces from clubs in the former NSL, including Preston Lions, Marconi Stallions and Wollongong Wolves.

Founded largely by migrant communities, many NSL and state league clubs became more than football teams — they were cultural hubs where generations of Australians with European, South American and Middle Eastern heritage found familiarity, connection and community.

body.en:

Lilian James didn't expect to find anyone tonight — let alone on a live dating show in front of about 200 people.

"The thought occurs to you, what if I find my soulmate tonight?" the 23-year-old tells SBS News, nervously laughing backstage before the show. "But I don't imagine that I will."

She's at Human Love Quest — a live, inclusive, modern-day version of the 1960s television dating show The Dating Game — staged in a Brunswick venue with sticky floors in the heart of Melbourne's inner north.

The gist is simple: three contestants vie for the affections of one eligible bachelor or bachelorette, with nothing but a flimsy board separating them from each other — personality over looks, by design.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Each contestant is asked a question, and they get to ask one back. One question earning a lot of thought tonight is a kiss, marry, kill scenario — cockroaches (marry), mosquitoes (kiss), or flies (kill).

The silliness is part of the DNA, say hosts Conor Gallacher and Xander Allan, complete with matching salmon suits. They staged their first show just after the COVID-19 pandemic, and it quickly evolved from a bit of fun to something people genuinely seemed to need.

"We thought it was just going to be a bit of fun," Allen tells SBS News. "But when we did it, people started really opening up. It became a lot more heartfelt than we thought it would be."

The matchmaking is deliberately low-tech — a Google form where prospective contestants write their name, a bit about themselves, and who they're looking for. Then it's largely a matter of throwing a group of people on stage and seeing what happens.

While the show has been running for years, Allan says he's noticed a shift in recent months, visible in the audience filing in.

James, for what it's worth, has been on and off dating apps since she was 18, deleting and redownloading them hundreds of times, but describes herself as "haphazard" about the whole thing — checking in once a week, liking a few people, then putting it down again. Routine.

"Dating apps have always been part of this scene and the environment," she says. "It's just part of life."

And yet. "No-one wants to be up at the altar and say, 'Oh, I knew you were the one when I liked you on Hinge,'" she says.

Match Group, which owns Tinder, Hinge and OkCupid, lost a net 704,000 paying subscribers over 2024, while Bumble's shares have fallen nearly 95 per cent since the pandemic.

summary.en: Reconciliation Week calls on Australians to go "All In". But for some migrants, joining the conversation is not so simple.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及合一、和好与弥合分歧。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
When Tiantian arrived in Australia in 2015, she knew some things about Aboriginal culture and the concept of reconciliation, but there were some things she didn't know she didn't know.

"I remember when I first came to Australia, I heard remarks from backpackers about First Nations people. After studying social work, I realised those remarks were actually discriminatory," Tiantian said.

"I don't think people were malicious, but I understand that those remarks often come from the lack of understanding about Australia's history."

At that early stage, she said she only had a basic understanding of the purpose of her university's National Reconciliation Week (NRW) event, which is dedicated to First Nations healing and truth-telling.

"At first I thought the NRW was similar to NAIDOC Week ," Tiantian, who prefers using her first name only, told SBS News. NAIDOC Week is an annual event led by First Nations communities to celebrate their culture and achievement, which is often held in July.

But when she became a social worker in Cairns, she made friends with her First Nations colleagues and engaged with local First Nations communities. Her understanding of NRW has significantly expanded.

This year, she decided to actively engage with NRW by sharing Chinese-language materials about it on her social media.

Tiantian's sharing was paid back. Many of her Chinese friends also shared their involvement with the NRW to her. "I feel we have more people practising and engaging with the NRW theme this year, which is ‘All In'," she said.

The theme is designed to encourage everyone to commit wholeheartedly to reconciliation, according to Reconciliation Australia, which curated the itinerary of the annual event. To ensure members of multilingual communities were included, it also provided translated posters and educational resources in 13 languages.

Despite the provision of these translated materials, however, even passionate volunteers like Tiantian have found it can be challenging for them to hold conversations about First Nations culture in their mother tongues.

Tiantian is a fluent English speaker and has mainly learned about First Nations history and culture in English. The difficulty for her comes during translation.

"Sometimes it takes time for me to express what I learned [in English] in Chinese, because I want to ensure my translation to Chinese is accurate," she said.
